source_refs.note: Topic 2.5.1.3 Default Parameters (PDF 47, printed 44). Short question 6 is answered.

blocks.title: Default parameter
blocks.text: A parameter can have a default value, which is used when no argument is given in the call.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)
blocks.text:
def greet(name="Student"):
....return "As-Salaam-Alaikum, " + name + "!"

print(greet())          # As-Salaam-Alaikum, Student!
print(greet("Umer"))    # As-Salaam-Alaikum, Umer!
